top_signals.title: Hungary’s Nuclear Power Returns as Rain Lifts Danube Water Levels
top_signals.summary: Hungary expects its only nuclear power plant to resume producing electricity as early as Monday evening after one of the turbines at the Paks nuclear plant is switched on, Prime Minister Peter Magyar said.     Hungary and Romania have been hit in the past weeks by power supply issues after the heatwaves and the lack of rainfall this summer led to the lowest water levels of the Danube in nearly 90 years. Hungary and Romania were forced to curb the respective nuclear power output of their plants that use the water from the river…

top_signals.title: Statement by Executive Vice-President Mînzatu on a proposal for a European Day in Remembrance of Victims of Accidents at Work ahead of the 70 year commemoration of the Marcinelle tragedy
top_signals.summary: European Commission Statement Brussels, 07 Aug 2026 Seventy years ago, on 8 August 1956, 262 workers of 12 nationalities, many of which from Italy, died in a fire at the Bois du Cazier coal mine in Marcinelle, Belgium. Most had come to Belgium in search of work and a better future. They never returned home.
